data.title: Viewz by Danube
data.about:
Aston Martin designed the interiors of the Viewz by Danube complex. This British luxury sports car maker has created a magnificent house with great furnishings and features. 

The apartments provide easy access to many means of transit, retail, eating, and shopping attractions in the surrounding area and are only a 10-minute walk from Dubai Metro. Viewz by Danube’s elegant Studio, 1, 2, and 3 Bedroom apartments, and exquisite Sky Villas provide stunning city and lake views. Viewz by Danube provides the most elite lifestyle in Dubai, with 40+ unique features.

location_tile.title: JLT is one of the most sought-after neighbourhoods in Dubai.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Jumeirah lakes towers is one of Dubai’s most coveted neighborhoods. With low prices and ample natural areas, the neighborhood is ideal for people seeking tranquil and convenient living close to the hustle and bustle of Dubai. JLT also has one of the nicest lifestyles, with man-made lakes surrounded by expansive green areas, shops, and a profusion of cafés and eateries. The finest feature of the community is that it provides the best views of JBR and Dubai Marina as well as the Dubai skyline.

10 Mins to Dubai Metro Station
11 Mins drive to Palm Jumeirah
20 Mins drive to Dubai Mall
28 Mins Al Maktoum International Airport
